title: Person: Wells
html_source:
This passage is marked in the Open Editions semantic edition as a person name.

Wells

anchor.prefix:
as. The prefect was at the door with some boys and Simon Moonan was knotting his false sleeves. He was telling them something about Tullabeg.

 Then he went away from the door and
anchor.suffix:
came over to Stephen and said:

 —Tell us, Dedalus, do you kiss your mother before you go to bed?

 Stephen answered:

 —I do.

 Wells turned to the other fellows and said:

 —O,
